feature_transform_for_balance_and_correl: log1p total plus and minus observed counts
score_diagnostics: Spearman correlation with each frozen scoring arm; constant vectors reported unavailable
uniform_comparator: radius 500; log-bias tracks fixed to zero; identical half-count prior, per-strand background, fixed deviance dispersion and detector geometry
uniform_shape: same fixed normalization fallback 1; report center, both shoulders, canonical sign and standardized functional separation
common_support: exact retained sites in previous comparison; no rematching or exclusions
interpretation: Associations do not establish causal confounding or overcorrection; uniform exposure is a control for the contribution of sequence correction to the spatial baseline.
